extraFacts.fact: The working load limit (WLL) is the maximum load a lifting component is rated to carry in service; proof load and minimum breaking load are test figures and are never used as working limits.
extraFacts.source: ASME B30.26 Rigging Hardware and EN 1677 Components for slings (definitions of working load limit and breaking force)

faqs.q: What is the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS and what is it used for?
faqs.a: Hook-type clamp with a twin-plate body and a roller at the top for the sling, for lifting plates and structural sections horizontally. The Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS follows QS type and is made in carbon steel, listed in 5 sizes with size range 1 t to 8 t and working load limit 1 to 8 t.

faqs.q: How are the Indus part numbers for the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS structured?
faqs.a: IH-LR-LC-QS is the base part number for the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS, and each size adds a suffix: IH-LR-LC-QS-1T is the 1 t row and IH-LR-LC-QS-8T the 8 t row. Every size has its own Indus part number in the size table.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS come in?
faqs.a: The Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS is listed in 5 sizes from 1 t to 8 t, with a working load limit of 1 to 8 t. The size table also lists WLL, weight, jaw opening.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS?
faqs.a: Choose the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS on WLL, not on size alone: 1 t is rated 1 t and 8 t is rated 8 t. Horizontal clamps lift in pairs or sets, spaced along the plate so it stays level. Choose by rated load and by jaw opening.

faqs.q: What is the working load limit of the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS?
faqs.a: The Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS has a working load limit of 1 to 8 t, depending on size, as the manufacturer rates it. The WLL is the most the part may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures, never working limits.

faqs.q: What is the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS made from?
faqs.a: The Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS is made from carbon steel. Finish: painted. Ask for an alternative finish or material on the RFQ if your site needs one.

faqs.q: Does the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS come with a test certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. Each consignment of the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS ships with the manufacturer’s test certificate, and the part follows QS type. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What should the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS be used with?
faqs.a: The Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS lifts steel plate or sections without drilling, so pair it with a sling or lifting beam rated at or above the clamp. A related listing is the [Horizontal Plate Lifting Clamp — Type L](/p/horizontal-plate-lifting-clamp-type-l).

faqs.q: How should the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS be inspected and used safely?
faqs.a: Inspect the Double Plate Lifting Clamp — Type QS before every lift and have it examined periodically by a competent person. Choose a plate clamp for the plate thickness range it grips and the orientation of the lift, and work to the load marked on the clamp. See our [lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae).
